moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Coventry's Big Return
angles.copy: Coventry City are back in the Premier League after 25 years and face a huge opener against the champions Arsenal on Friday night. What a welcome back!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals are set to take place over the UK August Bank Holiday weekend, from Thursday 27th to Sunday 30th August 2026, featuring a diverse lineup across multiple genres.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Counting down to the August Bank Holiday! Reading & Leeds Festival is just over a week away. Who's got their tickets ready?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Forget the weather, it's almost time for Reading & Leeds! The UK's biggest rock, pop and indie festival is back for the Bank Holiday weekend. What's your favourite festival memory?

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle turns 68

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle! 'Heaven Is A Place On Earth' is still an absolute anthem. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Blockhead Birthday
